title: Fixed Open-Truss Reflector and Rocker
description: One newly authored complete fixed open-truss reflector-style telescope display. A closed-back square mirror box opens into eight long exposed diagonal truss rods and a short hollow front cage carrying four thin spider members, a small diagonal secondary-style disc and a side eyepiece tube. Two large side bearing discs seat into matching concave rocker cheeks on a broad circular ground base. The main body has a genuinely open long span, not the old closed-cylinder tripod telescope recolored or resized; the complete ground-rocker support differs from the counterweighted equatorial stand. All parts form one fixed whole prop. Intentional finite overlaps fix static joints; no rotation range, balancing, optical prescription, focus, tracking, alignment, telescope compatibility, historical accuracy, engineering or safety claim.
